snippet.title: Steel Wound (steam trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107460/Steel_Wound/

Steam trailer for my upcoming game, Steel Wound. Release is still a way off, but development is chugging along at a steady pace. The game is inspired by a certain Amiga classic, those who know know.
